description: The paper doll texture tables the parts library reads every map name by (CjsCharacterTextureRoles, through CjsCharacterLibraryManager.GetTextureRoles), in the generic's own shape. `textureRoles`: the role of each suffix (a CjsCharacterDataTextureRole each: the property it draws into, what its channels hold, the composition operation or the role it is an input of, an empty `operation` or `inputOf` being none, replace or add, whether it is drawn through the option's diffuse coverage, its sources, and the facts no source states, `derived`); a `name` `<family>_<suffix>` is a role for that family alone. `textureRegions`: the regions a file name can carry. `textureAtlas`: where each region sits in the character atlas (a TransformUV0 rect, [u0, v0, u1, v1]). `textureAtlasTolerance`: how far an authored TransformUV0 rect may lie outside an atlas region and still be placed in it; rects are authored as floats (moved from Graphene atlasRegions.js). `textureGarmentMaps`: the garment map names, searched folder first, then size tier, then name, `<part>` the part folder's name and `*` any name. The five are one set: an installed library holding texture roles replaces them whole, and must hold all five. Ours: Carbon ships no paper doll, and the client's is Python. Only the library loads this file.

textureRoles.name: d
textureRoles.source: simpleblit: RGB = Texture.rgb, SRC_ALPHA/INV_SRC_ALPHA (character-compositing.md:370, :395); DiffuseMap (shaders.yaml partSlots)
textureRoles.derived: its alpha is coverage: matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 6a47517 augmentations.js:13)

textureRoles.name: l

channels.name: rgb
channels.value: detail, multiplied by the colour areas

textureRoles.derived: drawn as it is (Simple) without a zone map or palette (CjsPaperDollCompositor.CreateMaterialLayer); comp_body_l is a garment detail: matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 6a47517 bodyComposition.js:74)

textureRoles.name: z
textureRoles.source: colorizedblit Z, and the one-channel compact zone decode (character-compositing.md:367, :379-383)

textureRoles.name: comp_z
textureRoles.source: the colorizedblit Z decode (character-compositing.md:367, :379-383); every head tattoo folder holds one `comp_head_z` beside its `projection.proj` (resource index)
textureRoles.derived: PROVISIONAL (Ruru, 2026-11-09): the zone of the head tattoo's bake, which is its colourised detail (no source states it): matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 5a7e30d tattoos.js); every head tattoo's is a 16x16 map of one texel selecting colour area 1 everywhere (all 115, both sexes)

textureRoles.name: n

channels.name: rgb
channels.value: normal (or two-channel: R = X, A = Y, Z rebuilt)

textureRoles.source: covered SimpleBlit replacement (character-compositing.md:593); RGB at 4k, LA at base (:337-338)
textureRoles.derived: the coverage is the option's own diffuse: matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 6a47517 bodyComposition.js:146, hairSupport.js:144, beardSupport.js:67, augmentations.js:14)

textureRoles.name: s

channels.name: rgba
channels.value: specular (LA at base, RGBA in some variations)

textureRoles.derived: drawn by simpleblit, through the option's diffuse coverage as n; colorize_body_s is a boot's only specular: matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 6a47517 surfaceDetails.js:60, bodyComposition.js:63)

textureRoles.name: tn

channels.name: rg
channels.value: signed XY perturbation, (2 * value - 1) * strength / 2 (two-channel: A gives Y)

textureRoles.source: twistnormalblit, two passes ONE/ONE ADD then REV_SUBTRACT, destination alpha kept (character-compositing.md:373, :397)

textureRoles.name: mn
textureRoles.source: maskednormalblit: XY = 2 * rg - 1, alpha = b * strength; SRC_ALPHA/INV_SRC_ALPHA, destination alpha kept (character-compositing.md:372, :396)

textureRoles.name: m
textureRoles.source: black RGB, variable alpha, drawn through alpha onto a white target (character-compositing.md:341-348); CutMaskMap (shaders.yaml partSlots)
textureRoles.derived: the white target and a simpleblit: matches Graphene's working behaviour, today's look (Graphene 6a47517 bodyComposition.js:149, :335)
